result.question: Qual o crescimento percentual anual de internações no estado do RS entre 2008 e 2023?
result.gold_sql: SELECT ano, total_internacoes, LAG(total_internacoes) OVER (ORDER BY ano) AS ano_anterior, ROUND((total_internacoes - LAG(total_internacoes) OVER (ORDER BY ano)) * 100.0 / LAG(total_internacoes) OVER (ORDER BY ano), 2) AS pct_crescimento FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS' AND i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ano) sub ORDER BY ano;
result.generated_sql: WITH internacoes_por_ano AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" WHERE mu."estado" = 'RS' AND i."DT_INTER" BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY ano ), ano_2008 AS ( SELECT total_internacoes AS total_2008 FROM internacoes_por_ano WHERE ano = 2008 ), ano_2023 AS ( SELECT total_internacoes AS total_2023 FROM internacoes_por_ano WHERE ano = 2023 ) SELECT 100.0 * (a2023.total_2023 - a2008.total_2008) / a2008.total_2008 AS crescimento_percentual FROM ano_2008 a2008, ano_2023 a2023;
